notes.title: New life, new menu: Our biggest update is here!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey, fellow baristas![/h2]

[h3]Our long-awaited biggest (and hopefully last) update has arrived, with lots of tweaks and bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed bugs that lead to achievements not unlocking properly
[*] Fixed a lot of localization issues
[*] Fixed a bug with Art gallery pagination
[*] Fixed Steam SDK on Linux
[*] Fixed Steam Deck compatibility issues
[*] Fixed Notebook pagination issues
[*] Fixed a bug with the easy mode
[*] Fixed the pause menu where sometimes a softlock could occur
[*] Improved general controller support
[/list]

We've also fixed countless (nearly 100) smaller bugs, and included lots of minor updates to improve the overall gameplay experience.

Have a blast playing Zipp's Café![/h3]

...and don't forget to wishlist our other games from the Wilderness:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2362090/Chicken_Police_Into_the_HIVE/

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230450/Moses__Plato__Last_Train_to_Clawville/

[i]The Wild Gentlemen[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix #2 - Zipp's Café 1.0.2
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear players, dear friends, dear coffee lovers.[/h2]

The second hotfix batch has arrived!
You can read about the fixes below:

[list]
[*] Fixed a serious problem that was causing Linux and Steam Deck users to jam. (day 1 end progression bug)
[*] Fixed a couple of bugs that made some achievements unavailable. All achievements are now available to anyone.
[*] Fixed some Chinese and Russian localization issues.
[*] Cloud saving now works flawlessly.
[/list]

[i]The Wild Gentlemen team[/i]

notes.title: Hotfix #1 - Zipp's Café 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[h2]Dear players, dear friends, dear coffee lovers.[/h2]

We are working hard to give you the best experience and to eliminate any bugs [i]- not you, Frank -[/i] you are so diligently reporting to us.

The first hotfix batch has arrived. You can read about the fixes below:

[list]
[*] There were some problems with the Chinese translation (recipe glitch) and some missing characters, which have been fixed.
[*] The "librarian raccoon" achievement was not always available, this has been fixed.
[*] In the food-making tutorial a text window tended to get stuck. It has been fixed.
[*] There was also a bug during the coffee-making tutorial, this has been fixed too.
[*] We also fixed an issue, where 'continue' was available right at the first install of the game, which could cause some troubles later.
[*] In addition to other minor bug fixes, the profile system has been also redesigned.
[/list]

There are still problems with some achievements, we are working on them, so you can expect another update very soon. In addition, we will be fixing several other issues in the following days, before the first really big update arrives.
